offers_products.reason: Mainly leases modular offices and storage containers; sales of units are a minor side line.

offers_services.reason: Leases, delivers, installs and services mobile offices, storage containers and modular buildings; rental is the core offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are construction firms, schools, retailers, event organizers and other businesses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases to contractors like Turner Construction, schools, universities, dealerships, and government.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is monthly lease rent on units, with multi-month leases and add-on services like protection plans.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand is tied to construction projects and events, which customers can postpone or cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring monthly rental fees rather than buying a large unit; each lease is modest.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for rental use of a fleet of modular buildings and containers, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers range from large contractors like Turner to schools, dealerships and small businesses; no clear majority.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns the largest fleet of modular buildings and storage units in North America, needing ongoing fleet investment.

notes: Large-customer mix is uncertain; the answer rests on the website text and general knowledge of rental leasing.
